title: Gotrade Daily: After Hot CPI, CoreWeave and Costco Tonight
summary: October CPI came in hot and December rate-hike odds hit 91%. Tonight: CoreWeave after its beat, Nvidia, Costco's special dividend, Alibaba and Franco-Nevada.
body_markdown:
Fed Governor Christopher Waller backs a December hike, and Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan sees at least two more quarter-point hikes as needed, according to the same report.


### CoreWeave and Nvidia


**CoreWeave ([CRWV](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/crwv/) )** reported third-quarter revenue of $3.66 billion, up 168% and above the $3.55 billion estimate,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/10/coreweave-crwv-q3-earnings-report-2026.html) . Our[CoreWeave report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/coreweave-crwv-stock-news-november-11-2026/) has more.


**Nvidia ([NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) )** fell for a second straight session, cutting its market value to about $4.07 trillion, the lowest since late March, according to CNBC. Our[Nvidia report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-11-2026/) has the background.


### Costco and Alibaba


**Costco ([COST](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/cost/) )** declared a $30 per share special dividend, about $13.3 billion, for shareholders of record on Nov. 24,[according to its 8-K filing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/909832/000090983226000134/costex9918-k111026.htm) . For **Alibaba ([BABA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/baba/) )** , Singles' Day falls today,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/10/wednesdays-big-stock-stories-whats-likely-to-move-the-market.html) .


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


In CNBC's Tuesday night update, Dow futures were up 88 points, or 0.2%, S&P 500 futures rose 0.2% and Nasdaq 100 futures gained 0.4%.


In Tokyo, SoftBank Group fell as much as 10.5% after a 1.12 trillion yen (about $7.1 billion) quarterly loss,[according to Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/softbank-shares-tumble-after-7-bln-quarterly-loss-5017452) .


## Macro Note 📝


With the bond market closed, CME FedWatch is the main read on rates. It puts a 10% chance on a 50 basis point hike in December, according to Investing.com.


## Conclusion


Tonight the market tests two things: how much of a December rate hike is already priced in, and whether CoreWeave's results are enough to steady AI stocks.


Costco and Alibaba add a retail angle as the market opens at 9:30 a.m. ET.
